verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government industrial-property office. Its evidence describes filing, renewing, publishing and opposing patents, trademarks and designs. A user-configurable rules engine that fires actions on events is outside what a buyer would reasonably ask of a public IP registry service, and nothing in the pack shows it offers any event-triggered automation that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
